items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Keyboard-first time input with hour/minute/second segments and 12/24h support.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: International phone input with searchable country select, as-you-type formatting, E.164 output.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with visibility toggle plus optional strength meter and rule checklist.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Numeric input with steppers, hold-to-repeat, keyboard arrows, clamping, and Intl formatting.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Composable HSV color picker with saturation/value pad, hue and alpha sliders, hex input, and swatches.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: Canvas signature capture with pointer/touch/pen drawing, stroke-level undo, DPR-aware resize, and hidden form input.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Themed image cropper with zoom and optional rotation sliders, plus a canvas crop helper that returns a Blob.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie Consent
items.description: SSR-safe cookie banner with per-category preferences dialog, versioned localStorage consent, and a getStoredConsent helper.

items.name: event-calendar
items.title: Event Calendar
items.description: Month and week calendar with event chips, overlap-aware week layout, keyboard-navigable day grid, and controlled or uncontrolled view and date.
